from pathlib import Path

source='''def transform(grid):
    sep = next(i for i, value in enumerate(grid[0]) if value == 5)
    left = [row[:sep] for row in grid]
    right = [row[sep + 1:] for row in grid]
    overlap = any(a and b for left_row, right_row in zip(left, right) for a, b in zip(left_row, right_row))
    if overlap:
        return left
    return [[a if a else b for a, b in zip(left_row, right_row)] for left_row, right_row in zip(left, right)]
